description:
Sarah Chen (sarah@acmecorp.test), the marketing manager at AcmeCorp, is going on a two-week vacation. Configure an email autoresponder (vacation auto-reply) for her mailbox through the Virtualmin web interface.

Steps:
1. Select the domain 'acmecorp.test' in Virtualmin
2. Navigate to Edit Users for this domain
3. Click on the user 'sarah' to edit her settings
4. Enable the autoresponder (automatic reply) feature
5. Enter the following vacation message exactly:

Thank you for your email. I am currently out of the office on vacation from January 13 to January 24, 2025. I will have limited access to email during this time.

For urgent matters, please contact David Park at david@acmecorp.test.

I will respond to your email upon my return.

Best regards,
Sarah Chen
Marketing Manager, AcmeCorp

6. If there is an option for auto-reply interval (how often the same sender receives the reply), set it to 1 day (or 24 hours)
7. Save the configuration

The domain 'acmecorp.test' and user 'sarah' already exist. You are logged in as root.
